name: Halloween Tone & Spooky Vibe
criterion: Evaluates whether the general tone of the audit report feels sufficiently Halloween-appropriate and festive.

rating_scale.1: Tone is completely unsuited for Halloween.
rating_scale.2: Tone is dull and lacks seasonal spirit.
rating_scale.5: Tone is perfectly suited for a Halloween Trick-or-Treat audit.

name: Executive Readability & Polish
criterion: Measures how easy the report is to read and scan for a busy Trick-or-Treat route planner.

rating_scale.1: Extremely hard to read and understand.
rating_scale.2: Hard to follow in several places.
rating_scale.5: Effortless to read, well-structured, and clearly formatted.

name: Deep Confectionery Passion
criterion: Evaluates if the report contains deep, smart, and passionately insightful commentary about candy culture.

rating_scale.1: Zero passion or insight, just plain copying of data.
rating_scale.5: Brilliant, outstanding, and deeply passionate candy sommelier insights.

name: Explicit Candy Tier & Wrapper Specs
criterion: Explicitly states the exact house_id, primary candy name, size_class, wrapper_status, guild_tier, and street_trade_ratio in the body of the report.

rating_scale.1: Two or more core specs (house_id, size_class, wrapper_status, guild_tier, street_trade_ratio) are missing or incorrect.
rating_scale.2: States most core specs, but omits wrapper_status or street_trade_ratio.
rating_scale.3: States all core specs but buries them inside unstructured paragraphs.
rating_scale.4: States all core specs accurately and clearly in the text, though not consolidated in a summary table.
rating_scale.5: Prominently and accurately displays exact house_id, size_class, wrapper_status, guild_tier, and street_trade_ratio in both summary tables and text.

name: Unit Cost-Per-Treat & $/Oz Math
criterion: Derives and explicitly states both the mathematical Cost-Per-Treat (total_spend_usd / piece_count) and Cost-Per-Ounce (total_spend_usd / total_weight_oz), benchmarking the unit cost against the $0.50/treat Golden Pumpkin threshold.

rating_scale.1: Unit cost-per-treat and cost-per-ounce calculations are entirely omitted or mathematically incorrect (only raw total spend or piece count is stated).
rating_scale.2: Alludes to candy generosity relative to total spend, but provides no numerical $/treat or $/oz figure or formula.
rating_scale.3: Calculates either Cost-Per-Treat ($/piece) or Cost-Per-Ounce ($/oz), but omits the other or omits the derivation formula.
rating_scale.4: Correctly computes both Cost-Per-Treat ($/piece) and Cost-Per-Ounce ($/oz) with clear division formulas, but does not benchmark against the $0.50/treat Golden Pumpkin threshold.
rating_scale.5: Accurately calculates and highlights both exact Cost-Per-Treat ($/piece) and Cost-Per-Ounce ($/oz) with explicit derivation formulas and benchmarks against the $0.50/treat Golden Pumpkin threshold.

name: Neighboring Bowl Cross-Contact Risk
criterion: Inspects all neighboring_bowls on the porch alongside the primary candy bowl, explicitly identifying adjacent unwrapped allergens (peanuts, tree nuts) and evaluating cross-contact risk from shared tongs, nested troughs, or residue.

rating_scale.1: Only evaluates the primary candy bowl (main_bowl_allergens) and completely omits or ignores neighboring_bowls on the porch.
rating_scale.2: Vaguely mentions that other bowls may exist on the porch without listing their contents or specific allergens.
rating_scale.3: Mentions the neighboring bowl contents but fails to list the specific allergens (e.g., peanuts, tree nuts) or wrapper status.
rating_scale.4: Identifies the neighboring bowls and their specific allergens, but provides only a brief mention of cross-contact mechanics.
rating_scale.5: Thoroughly documents every neighboring bowl's location, contents, wrapper status, and specific allergens (peanuts/tree nuts), issuing an explicit Cross-Contamination Warning explaining why the porch is unsafe despite the primary bowl's peanut-free label.
